references.text: The lot was used to distribute inheritances among the tribes, as commanded through Moses.
Joshua cast lots for the tribes at Shiloh before the Lord.
Joshua instructed the men to go out and survey the land before casting lots at Shiloh.
Summary of the distribution by lot at Shiloh, before the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
God's command that the land be divided by lot among the tribes.
The Lord commanded that the land be distributed by lot as an inheritance to the tribes.
Moses gave the command that the land be divided by lot for the nine and a half tribes.
The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord – God's sovereignty over casting lots.
Casting lots was used to choose Matthias as an apostle, continuing the tradition of seeking God's will through the lot.
Paul refers to how God divided the land among the tribes of Israel as their inheritance.
